items.q: Whose turn is it to do the watering this week?

items.answer: Cut back the boundary hedge (Dot); Clear the drainage ditch (Hal); Return the borrowed rotavator (Josef); Renew the public liability insurance (Tomas)

items.q: What does Priya need to do before the committee meeting on Thursday 18 March?
items.answer: Priya needs to book the skip for the clear-out by Wednesday 17 March (the permit has come through) and send round the AGM minutes by Thursday 18 March (the draft is done).

items.q: Is anything waiting on the council? If so, what?
items.answer: Yes—two open tasks: **Fix the main gate lock** (Wren; waiting on Council estates team, due 22 March) and **Get the water meter replaced** (Hal; waiting on council, visit not booked yet, due 25 March). The completed task **Report the fly-tipping by the gate** (Ines) is also annotated “waiting on council.”

items.q: Who is going to repaint the noticeboard?
items.answer: Nobody yet — the task is unassigned

items.q: Has the number of manure loads been decided? If so, how many?
items.answer: No — the number of loads is still to be decided at the meeting.
Josef is strimming the top half; Dot is strimming the bottom half.
